title: T232 PNC - When Saying 'Praise G-d from the Heavens' — One Commands All Creation
hebrewTitle: בעת אמירת 'הללו את ה׳ מן השמים' — האדם מצוֵה על הכל
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: When you say "Praise G-d from the heavens, praise Him all His angels, praise Him all His hosts" (Psalms 148), you are not just praying — you are calling out to all of creation and commanding everything to praise Hashem. In that moment, the human being takes on a remarkable role: standing as the conductor of cosmic praise. Every angel, every star, every creature is summoned by your words to join in praise. This elevates the simple recitation of a Psalm into an act of cosmic leadership. The human is the priest who orchestrates universal worship.

intermediate.en: T232: When reciting "Hallelu et Hashem min ha-shamayim... hallelu hu kol malachav, hallelu hu kol tzeva'av" (Psalms 148), the person calls upon and commands all creation to praise Hashem. The reciter takes the role of conductor of cosmic worship. LM 232.
intermediate.he: בעת אמירת "הללו את ה׳ מן השמים" (תהלים קמח) — האדם קורא לכל הבריאה ומצוֶה אותה להלל. האדם הופך מנצח על שירת העולם.

scholarly.he: LM א׳ רל״ב — תהלים קמח "הללו את ה׳ מן השמים"; אומר התהלים הוא מצַוה על כל הבריאה להלל.
